summary: Kamada Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on 18 June 2026 announcing an Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for 5 August 2026 in Rehovot, Israel. The agenda includes re-election of seven directors and two external directors, approval of director option grants, an amendment to increase the share reserve under the 2011 Israeli Share Award Plan, and ratification of Kost Forer Gabbay Kasierer (Ernst & Young) as auditor for FY2026. The record date is 23 June 2026. Board recommends voting FOR all proposals. This filing is a routine proxy statement; no special-situation transaction, premium, or structural change is involved. What to watch: ordinary shareholder vote; no risk-arb angle.
